CREATE TABLE `configuracao_fiscal` (
  `id` int(11) NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `municipal_service_id` varchar(50) DEFAULT NULL,
  `municipal_service_code` varchar(20) DEFAULT NULL,
  `municipal_service_name` varchar(500) DEFAULT NULL,
  `descricao_servico_padrao` text DEFAULT NULL,
  `iss_percentual` decimal(5,2) DEFAULT 5.00,
  `cofins_percentual` decimal(5,2) DEFAULT 0.00,
  `csll_percentual` decimal(5,2) DEFAULT 0.00,
  `inss_percentual` decimal(5,2) DEFAULT 0.00,
  `ir_percentual` decimal(5,2) DEFAULT 0.00,
  `pis_percentual` decimal(5,2) DEFAULT 0.00,
  `reter_iss` tinyint(1) DEFAULT 0,
  `emissao_automatica` tinyint(1) DEFAULT 0,
  `ativo` tinyint(1) DEFAULT 1,
  `created_at` timestamp NULL DEFAULT current_timestamp(),
  `updated_at` timestamp NULL DEFAULT current_timestamp() ON UPDATE current_timestamp(),
  `empresa_id` int(11) DEFAULT 1,
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
  KEY `fk_empresa_configuracao_fiscal` (`empresa_id`),
  CONSTRAINT `fk_empresa_configuracao_fiscal` FOREIGN KEY (`empresa_id`) REFERENCES `empresas` (`id`) ON DELETE CASCADE
) ENGINE=InnoDB AUTO_INCREMENT=2 DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_unicode_ci
